question: Do past-only radius asymmetry features improve prediction of future ring overtaking beyond motion and size?
system: Dyed water vortex rings, not air-filled bubble rings

allowed: Phone kept dry and outside the water

apparatus_candidates_not_validated.generator: Syringe or piston with a measured circular outlet
apparatus_candidates_not_validated.camera: Fixed side view; target 60 fps or higher

development_phase.purpose: Establish repeatable visible rings and reliable identities
development_phase.evaluation_use: Development trials are excluded from confirmation
development_phase.freeze_requirement: Finalize apparatus and analysis settings before evaluation data collection

pilot_candidates.settling: Determine during development; do not assume 60 seconds is sufficient

labels.overtaking: Second-emitted ring passes first-emitted ring in the future window with reliably maintained identities
labels.no_overtaking: Both rings remain trackable throughout the future window and no passage occurs
labels.ambiguous: Identity, visibility, breakdown, or marking uncertainty prevents reliable classification
labels.already_overtaken: Passage occurred at or before prediction time; reported separately
labels.feature_unavailable: Insufficient history, stale frame, or invalid tracking; reported separately

evaluation_plan.candidate_split: 20 development/training trials and 10 held-out trials if enough eligible trials exist
evaluation_plan.missing_trials: Report realized counts; do not silently replace exclusions
evaluation_plan.permutation_control: Specify the null, permutation scheme, statistic and repetitions before evaluation; no assumed 50 percent target
evaluation_plan.sample_size_boundary: Feasibility pilot, not a broadly validated predictor

measurement_uncertainty.procedure: Independently re-mark a prespecified frame subset without seeing prediction results
report: Sensitivity of features and predictions to marking changes

claim_limits: No reconnection claim from projected overlap
No Mobius or Klein topology claim
